learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to sort our toys, put them in groups, and find out which toy we have the most!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Let's put all the toy cars together in one place and all the soft toys in another. This is called sorting! It makes our room look very neat.
Now let us count the toys in each group. 1, 2, 3 cars! 1, 2 soft toys! Counting helps us know exactly how many toys we have.
Look at the numbers! We have 3 cars and 2 soft toys. 3 is bigger than 2. So, we have the most cars and the least soft toys.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Toy Sorting Race!
fun_activity.instructions: Mix your toys on the floor. Now quickly sort them by color! Put all red toys in one group and all blue in another. Which color won?

quick_recap: ⭐ Sorting means putting similar things together in groups.
⭐ We can count groups to see which one has the most things.
⭐ The group with the smallest number has the least things.
